implementation_notes: Swift matches tuples and enum cases carry payloads, so `switch (a, b)` with enumeration-case patterns resolves both runtime values in one construct and the compiler requires the switch to be exhaustive for enums - the accept/visit round-trip has nothing left to do for types you own. For class hierarchies the same construct works with type-casting patterns (`case (let c as Circle, let s as Square)`), but the compiler then demands a default arm because class patterns are not provably exhaustive, so missing pairs become a runtime path; that is the point where the protocol visitor (see visitor-protocol) takes over.
pitfalls: Class-based tuple patterns always need a default arm, so missing pairs surface at runtime: throw from it instead of returning a neutral value.
Exhaustiveness only holds for enums: do not add @unknown default to a sealed switch, that is the guarantee you paid for.
Large switches over tuples are expensive to type-check and can slow builds noticeably.

variants.name: Visitor protocol with accept (existential dispatch)
variants.idiom_name: protocol ShapeVisitor + func accept(_ v: ShapeVisitor)
variants.implementation_notes: The classic structure maps onto protocols: each element implements accept(_:) by calling the visitor method for its own type, so the element axis is resolved by static overload resolution and the visitor axis by protocol-witness dispatch. It is the option when element types are open (third-party conformances), when operations must be first-class objects for injection or mocking, or when the visitor interface itself is the extension point; a generic visitor (func accept<V: ShapeVisitor>(_ v: inout V)) keeps the second axis statically dispatched, while `any ShapeVisitor` existentials add a witness-table lookup per call.
pitfalls: A convenience visit(_ shape: Shape) implemented in a protocol extension is statically dispatched, so conforming types silently stop customising it.
Non-requirement protocol extension methods are always dispatched statically: 'overridden' behaviour in a concrete visitor is ignored.
Existentials (any ShapeVisitor) box and indirect the value; pass visitors as generic parameters when performance matters.
